progress_help_progress_desc_1: View a seasonal breakdown of collection progress to 100% completion.
progress_help_progress_desc_2: Each member can be further broken down into just physical (A) or digital (Z) collections, instead of combined.
progress_help_progress_desc_3: Unobtainable objekts such as those from limited time events do not count towards reaching 100%. Owning one is shown as a bonus next to the class it belongs to.
progress_help_progress_desc_4: Progress breakdowns are updated every hour.
progress_help_leaderboard_desc_1: Leaderboards display the top 25 users for the given member, which is based on the total number of unique collections the user has, not the total number of objekts they own.
progress_help_leaderboard_desc_2: Leaderboard percentages completely exclude unobtainable objekts, so your progress percentage may differ from your leaderboard percentage.
progress_help_leaderboard_desc_3: Leaderboards update as objekts are transferred.
progress_help_leaderboard_desc_4: Collectors with the same count share a rank, and are listed by wallet address.
grid_include_dialog_description: Event rewards can be non-transferable but still usable for grids in COSMO. Included copies only affect this view and reset on reload.
grid_include_empty: You don't own any non-transferable copies for this edition.

grid_select_prompt: Select an artist or member to view grids.
grid_help_desc_1: Shows how many grids you can complete right now for each member, season and edition, based on the objekts you own.
grid_help_desc_2: Only transferable objekts count towards grids. Non-transferable event rewards can be included manually per edition, which only affects your current view.
grid_help_desc_3: Rewards show how many of each grid reward Special class objekt you own. Completing a grid grants one of the two at random.
grid_help_desc_4: For idntt, gridding one Special from two different members produces that pairing's Unit objekt.
grid_help_desc_5: Raise an edition's target to plan multiple grids and see the total copies needed. Each completion still grants a random Special, so completing two grids does not guarantee both.
